title: Semantic Preservation
proposition: Semantic preservation means a change retains the behavior required by the same contract for the validated input domain.
scope: Technology-neutral curriculum statement for V01-C27 within Volume 01 Programming Foundations.
exceptions: Concrete implementations, organizational practices, or domain constraints may require a narrower application of this proposition.
score_rationale: Independent Tier 1 curriculum evidence and Tier 2 official documentation support the bounded proposition; formal Claim Review remains required before production approval.
